full_page.content:
1936, March
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 103 Cont.
Mar. 27 Mrs. F1. Durand of St. Clair, Mich, - 45 - n. Cath. tuomer - fears operation
Walter LeCroix - piles etc .... Son drinks. Dr. Benj. Loringer - about 40 - cancer of neck. 1936, April
Page 104
Apr. 1st Baby John Solarz - 10 mo. - clot on brain - parents hope & pray oper- ation be not necessary.
John E. Bricault -22 - graduate .... out of work ....
Russell Drummond - 10 - infantile paraly. - from Northville. Only practical Cath. in family ....
Norm Boddy - 15 no. - eczema - not baptized .... Father 31 .... unbelie- ver objects to wife going to church.
Mrs. Millis - 77 - laments husband away 18 mo's - does not
Margaret Quinlan - 30 - infected eye since Jan. Ist - had hemorage. .
Dorothy West - 18 - away from home and in dangerous comp. Louise Oldini - 67 - double pneumon. Roice Little - 21 - non Cath. n.g. about work - don't care.
Page 105 Apr.
R.S. Lohman & sausage maker ... hones- trying to make honest living. Partner proved crooked .....
Mary Cath Hogan of - 1 - cleft palate.
Walter Daly - 16 - tuomer - grew too fast 6 ft. 4 in. Philip & Rose Apolito .... Victims of (want of practical faith) super- stitious - five years away from sacraments.
7th Joseph Poppenbeierger ... butcher ... sausage maker .. "crooked" Enrolled To-day.
